selection.criterion: Recorded first-call loading and all reported timing and memory fields.
selection.reason: No recorded loading interval in the first invocation.

hardware.host_scope: Three nodes; shared host memory, storage and caches.
hardware.cpu_scope: Four CPU-affinity identifiers per configuration; numerical-library thread limits of four. Identifiers do not establish four independent physical cores.

protocol.trials: Three complete warm-ups then three measured calls, sequentially in the same interpreter; output and clip state recreated for every call. Pre, Gen, Post and Call summarize the three measured calls; sample SD uses n-1.
protocol.first_load: first_load_s is the loading interval in the first recorded invocation, warmup_01: one observation, with disk caches potentially already populated. It cannot be added to warmed stage means to obtain a measured total. statistics.load_s and trial load_s retain their per-call meanings.
protocol.publication_year: Year of the cited publication, matching the current manuscript tables.
protocol.residency: 10 configurations retain audited model objects; 41 reload models every call while retaining interpreter/kernel caches.
protocol.timing: Implementation-specific synchronized stage unions. Call spans inference entry to synchronized return; it includes per-call loading, native validation and unclassified overhead. Generic output QA follows Call.
protocol.suite_time: suite_process_s covers the entire 3+3 process, including setup, warm-ups, measured calls, QA and shutdown. It is neither single-call latency nor TTFF; do not divide by six to estimate measured latency.
protocol.memory: Approximately 100-ms own-process/worker NVML sampling. measured_nvml_peak_gib is the maximum of three measured-window peaks; first_warmup_nvml_peak_gib is the first call; suite_nvml_peak_gib includes setup, all calls and QA.
protocol.inputs: Unless stated otherwise, inputs follow the demo recommended in the official open-source README. Wav2Lip+GAN uses the EDTalk pair and FOMM uses the TPS pair. Third-party implementations use their supplied demos. Lengths, dimensions, sampling, precision, offloading and precomputed prerequisites differ across repositories.
protocol.metadata: Labels for 44 included implementations are historical execution observations; seven use source/configuration inspections. Package versions and Git heads are post-run inventories.
protocol.limits: These runtime trials do not measure matched-input quality, TTFF, delivery jitter or continuous-session drift. Separate quality benchmarks are reported in benchmark-results-v12.json. Three short repetitions do not establish sustained service.
protocol.missing: The displayed subset has all table metrics. Null/empty fields elsewhere in the underlying records mean unavailable, not zero. Unrecorded sampler and decoder defaults for six configurations remain unspecified.
protocol.provenance: The workbook is supported by archived JSON reports, iteration records, phase events, NVML samples and output videos. The 306 included calls and aggregate statistics were reconciled; original exports preserve all 336 calls. Adapter source, model weights and complete environments were not supplied.
